reuse.why: Hooks the recurring-day match into the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate that every holiday/weekend path in shared/schedules.ts already uses.

duplication.why: One small isHoliday function; no logic repeated.

placement.why: The holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts beside isNonWorkingDay, the single place the tree decides non-working days.

scope.why: A three-line helper plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Very easy to own; matching MM-DD via day.slice(5) is implicit about the format and does no validation of entries, which a comment only partly covers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay -> isHoliday.
